headline: Ethio-Djibouti railway goes digital, requiring online submission of all incoming letters
summary: The Ethio-Djibouti Railway Share Company has moved to a paperless correspondence system. All external communications must now be submitted and tracked online from November 23.
why: The Ethio-Djibouti railway is a key freight link between Ethiopia and the port of Djibouti, so its operational changes affect logistics for landlocked Ethiopian trade.
